payload.author: claude
payload.body: Implementation complete, pending adversarial review. crates/frick-protocol ports frame.ts (all 23 FrameKinds, custom [kind,payload] serde), codec.ts (packed tuples), schema.ts (AST + validateSchema with exact TS error messages), errors.ts (16 codes + envelope), compatibility.ts, capabilities.ts, calls.ts (internally-tagged CallCommandOp). Golden fixtures: packages/protocol/scripts/generate-wire-fixtures.ts (pnpm fixtures:wire) emits 38 binary cases to conformance/fixtures/wire/; Rust harness asserts rmpv byte round-trip + manifest semantic match + typed decode + byte-identical typed re-encode (37/38; 1 case decode-only by design). All green: cargo fmt/clippy -D warnings/test. Key encoding facts: payload key order = TS interface declaration order; Schema frames serialize key-sorted (validateSchema stableClone); minimal-width ints match @msgpack/msgpack defaults.
